finding.claim: When system.http_x_forwarded.ip is enabled, Uri::ip() trusts the leftmost X-Forwarded-For hop, which a client can set. Low severity: no core callers of Uri::ip() exist, so impact depends on plugins that use the IP for throttling or audit.
finding.sink: Uri::ip() return value used as client IP

trace.note: Gate: ip candidates added only when enabled
array_shift takes leftmost (client-controlled when proxy appends) entry

finding.guards_checked: Each forwarded header is opt-in and defaults to false (system/config/system.yaml:14-17; comment Uri.php:692-697). No in-tree consumers of Uri::ip() (grep found none).

finding.claim: HTTP Range header is parsed without validation. Suffix ranges (bytes=-N) are served as bytes 0..N, and start>end yields a negative Content-Length. Logic error only: all values are integers, so no header injection or disclosure beyond the already-authorized file.
finding.sink: Content-Length / Content-Range headers and fseek() offset

trace.note: explode on '=' takes the range spec
explode on '-' yields start and end strings
(int) cast of start, no bounds check
(int) cast of end, no start<=end or end<size check
new_length can be negative or oversized

finding.guards_checked: Values are integer-cast, so no CRLF injection. Caller only reaches this for a file already resolved by the page/media lookup.

finding.claim: Page-folder fallback serves any file in the page folder whose basename matches the URL. Unverified: whether source-like extensions (md, yaml) are in media.types, which would expose raw page source.
finding.source: URL path basename (Uri::basename) and URL extension

trace.note: Extension must be in supported_types (media types)
Utils::download on page path joined with URL basename

finding.guards_checked: Basename prevents path traversal (Utils.php:1083-1091). Extension gate at Grav.php:864-869. Effective media.types config not verified.

finding.claim: Page index cache payloads are unserialized without allowed_classes restriction. Exploitation requires prior write access to the cache directory, not reachable over HTTP. Informational; same pattern at Pages.php:443 and PageIndexStore.php:292,316,338.
finding.source: Page-index SQLite store payload under cache (local, not HTTP)
finding.guards_checked: Source is local cache only; no HTTP-controlled write path found in the audited code.

finding.claim: Dev router writes full REQUEST_URI to error_log, which can include tokens or nonces in query strings. Conflicts with the org rule against logging sensitive data. Applies only to the PHP built-in dev server.
finding.guards_checked: Only active under the PHP built-in server (system/router.php is a dev router).
